itemUsage.en: Demetri, former advisor of Famiglia Bellone's former heir Leontuzzo, now don of the Bellones himself.
itemUsage.zh: 贝洛内家族过去的少爷莱昂图索曾经的军师，德米特里，如今已是贝洛内家的家主。

itemDesc.en: There must be one ahead to clear the thorny way, and one behind to ensure their protection.
itemDesc.zh: 需要有人在前披荆斩棘，也需要有人在后提供保障。

description.en:
ATK <@ba.vup>+{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].atk:0%}</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].attack_speed}</>, and attacks have a <@ba.vup>{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].prob:0%}</> chance to deal <@ba.vup>{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].prob_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage; immediately chooses a ground target within range, and if said target is on a deployable tile, <$ba.addash>Moves</> to target's position and attacks; if target is an Elite or Leader enemy and is defeated, or if Bellone does not attack for <@ba.vup>1</> second, a new target will be chosen
<@ba.rem>Upon receiving lethal damage, skill ends instead of retreating; returns to initial position when skill ends</>
description.zh: 攻击力<@ba.vup>+{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].atk:0%}</>，攻击速度<@ba.vup>+{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].attack_speed}</>，攻击时有<@ba.vup>{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].prob:0%}</>的几率造成相当于攻击力<@ba.vup>{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].prob_atk_scale:0%}</>的物理伤害；技能开启后立即选取自身周围一定范围内的一名地面目标，若其所在位置可部署，自身会<$ba.addash>移动</>至目标所在位置进行攻击；自身攻击的精英、领袖敌人被击倒，或自身持续<@ba.vup>1</>秒未进行攻击时，会立即重新选取目标\n<@ba.rem>受到致命伤害时不撤退但会结束技能，技能结束后返回初始位置</>

ATK <@ba.vup>+{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].atk:0%}</>, ASPD <@ba.vup>+{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].attack_speed}</>, and attacks have a <@ba.vup>{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].prob:0%}</> chance to deal <@ba.vup>{attack@demetr_s3[bonus].prob_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK as Physical damage; immediately chooses a ground target within range, and if said target is on a deployable tile, <$ba.addash>Moves</> to target's position and attacks; if target is an Elite or Leader enemy and is defeated, or if Bellone does not attack for <@ba.vup>1</> second, a new target will be chosen
<@ba.rem>Upon receiving lethal damage, skill ends instead of retreating; returns to initial position when skill ends</>

description.en:
Even now, as he blends drinks in his private bar in Nuova Volsinii, Demetri occasionally thinks back to the last time they were gathered around the dinner table of the Bellones' house.
He had met with his informant in the Famiglia Rossati earlier that day, and returned home to see the dinner table already set up. It was not a particularly special day, but it was a rare one: Leon was back from the Ministero dei Lavori Pubblici, and both Bernardo and Lavinia were home. Such occasions had become hard to come by.
He sat down in his usual seat and began to talk about the information he had garnered, but Bernardo took a glance at the look on Lavinia's face and interrupted him. He knew that Lavinia, unlike the other famiglia-backed judges, had her own ideas about the mafiosi of Siracusa, but assumed the day would eventually come when she truly became a part of Bellone. That Bernardo only meant that now was not the time.
He decided to give his report later that night. The information gathering operation had been Demetri's own idea. Bernardo had been giving him fewer orders recently, allowing him to act on his own judgment most of the time. The famiglie were stirring as the new city neared completion, and he felt the need to be aware of their movements. It was his duty as the advisor to the Bellones, after all. He would prove to Bernardo that he was worthy to carry the famiglia's future.
He carved the stewed meat with his knife and served the soup for the others. The heavy atmosphere brought about by his news of Rossati's movements had dissipated—Leon was chatting excitedly about what he saw at the Ministero dei Lavori Pubblici, with the occasional comment by Lavinia. Bernardo said little, but nodded from time to time. The Ministero dei Lavori Pubblici has long been closely watched by the famiglie, and those experiences were of no doubt mixed with bloodshed and violence, yet Leon's words seemed to carry hope and expectation, as though they were heralding a brand-new future that was completely different from the past.
Demetri thought his words were naive. Not that there was anything wrong with naivete, of course. It was only natural that the future Don should expand his horizons, so that when the time came to take over, he would have the vision to see the big picture and choose the best course of action. He would have to understand and take care of all of the famiglia's members, and ensure Bellone's continued prosperity. Though Leon's path had deviated somewhat from his expectations, Demetri had believed that he would groom Leon into the perfect Don, at which point he and his knife would become the Don's perfect tools.
Thinking back now, perhaps he was the truly naive one.
Demetri cuts the ice cube into a sphere with his knife, and places it into the glass. This knife has been with him for so many years and remains a useful instrument to this day; he is much the same.
description.zh:
即使是现在，在新沃尔西尼的私人酒吧里为自己调酒时，德米特里偶尔还是会想起在贝洛内家最后一次与大家共进晚餐的那个夜晚。
那天他刚去见了安插在罗塞蒂家族的线人，回到家里，餐桌上已经布好了晚餐的前菜，不是什么特殊的日子，但又很难得，莱昂从建设部回来了，贝纳尔多和拉维妮娅也在。不知从什么时候起，大家像这样齐聚在一起，坐在桌边的次数就越来越少了。
他在为他预留了餐具的座位前坐下，自然而然地说起了自己查访到的情报，但贝纳尔多看了一眼面色沉下来的拉维妮娅，打断了他。他知道拉维妮娅与其他有家族支持的法官不同，对叙拉古的“家族”有一些别的想法，但他当时觉得，迟早有一天她也会成为贝洛内家的一员，只是贝纳尔多认为还没到时候，所以有些话不适合在她面前说。
他决定晚些再找贝纳尔多单独汇报。这些日子以来，贝纳尔多向他直接发布的命令已逐渐减少，更多时候，贝纳尔多会任由他自主行动，因此这些情报都是他自行搜集的。随着新移动城市建设逐渐完成，各个家族蠢蠢欲动，他认为有必要掌握其他家族的动向，这是他作为贝洛内家军师应当承担的职责。他将向贝纳尔多证明，自己是个合格的军师，值得托付家族的未来。
炖肉和汤端上来之后，他掏出随身的匕首为席间的众人切了肉，又分了汤。罗塞蒂家族的动向带来的沉重气氛在此时已经消散，莱昂兴致勃勃地讲起了他在建设部的见闻，拉维妮娅时不时会点评几句，贝纳尔多虽然没有多说什么，但偶尔也会点头表示赞同。建设部是个被众多家族盯着的地方，那些所见所闻里同样掺杂着叙拉古常见的家族争斗带来的血腥与暴力，但不知为何，当它们从莱昂的嘴里说出来的时候，又带着一些希望与朝气，似乎未来会有全新的变化，与从前完全不同。
在当时的德米特里看来，莱昂说的话透着一股天真。但这也没什么不好，未来的家主当然应该多接触各种不同的人和事，这样当他继承贝洛内家时，就能更好地纵观全局，做出最清晰明确的指示，同时也能更好地体谅与关怀家族里的每一个成员，让贝洛内家继续发展壮大。尽管莱昂现在的道路多少有些偏离他的预想，但德米特里相信，在自己的辅佐与培养之下，总有一天，莱昂会成为最完美的家族领袖，而到了那时，他将与他手中的匕首一样，成为莱昂最实用的工具。
如今想来，那一天晚上，真正天真的人恐怕只有他自己。
德米特里用匕首将冰块切成圆球，放入面前的酒杯之中。这把匕首跟随了他许多年，至今依然实用，他也同样如此。
